item.text: [{"task_id":"456873bc","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    fg = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    band = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    mark = int(round(params['colors'][3]))","    gap = int(round(params['layout'][0]))","    axis = int(round(params['layout'][1]))","    direction = int(round(params['layout'][2]))","    g = grid.copy()","    if axis == 1:","        g = g.T","    h, w = g.shape","    positions = np.argwhere(g == band)","    if len(positions) == 0:","        return g","    rlo = int(np.min(positions[:, 0]))","    rhi = int(np.max(positions[:, 0]))","    clo = int(np.min(positions[:, 1]))","    chi = int(np.max(positions[:, 1]))","    size = min(rhi - rlo + 1, chi - clo + 1)","    pitch = size + gap","    if pitch <= 0:","        return g","    template = None","    for r in range(0, h, pitch):","        for c in range(0, w, pitch):","            block = g[r:r + size, c:c + size]","            if block.shape == (size, size) and np.any(block == fg):","                if template is None:","                    template = block.copy()","    if template is None:","        return g","    cells = np.argwhere(template == fg).tolist()","    if direction < 0:","        cells.reverse()","    out = np.full((h, w), bg, dtype=int)","    for index in range(len(cells)):","        rr, cc = cells[index]","        top = rr * pitch","        left = cc * pitch","        if top + size <= h and left + size <= w:","            out[top:top + size, left:left + size] = template","            mr, mc = cells[index]","            out[top + mr, left + mc] = mark","    if axis == 1:","        out = out.T","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[4],"layout":[3]},"params":{"colors":[0,2,3,8],"layout":[1,0,1]},"rationale":"The repeated red object is also the blueprint for the arrangement of objects. The green strip conceals missing copies and gives the object size. Reconstruct the full arrangement, then mark successive red pixels in successive copies, both in row-major order."}]
